seamTolerancePolicy: Diagnostic compare against internal mean and95th-percentile whole-line gradients; numbers are symptoms, final decision requires actual3x3 visual review. No pixels blended/wrapped/retouched by processing.

preview.operation: Byte-preserved source repeated3x3 at native size then reduced to1536² for inspection; not new generated detail

acceptanceScope: Native ground-art and3x3 visible repeat only; no Unity shader, camera movement, actor-overlay readability or device acceptance claimed
visualFindings: Top-down opaque warm-grey/blue-grey hand-painted soil/flat-stone texture; low-contrast sparse pale jade moss
No sky, perspective, building, center emblem, road, text, border or collision obstacle
Actual3x3 native repetition (reduced inspection preview) has no prominent straight seam or lighting band at either join pair; periodic repeated stone clusters remain visible as expected for one tile
Natural rock variation across edges is acceptable at inspection scale; opposite edge pixels are NOT numerically identical

diagnosticThresholds.policy: 2x limit is a local diagnostic acceptance bound, not an industry standard or proof of exact seamlessness. Visual3x3 review required as well.

warnings.action: Keep original native pixels; no upscale or claimed2048-native detail
Accepted as natural hand-painted visual repeat; do not label mathematically exact pixel-periodic tile

imageProcessingPerformed: Source bytes unchanged. Only native3x3 repetition and downscaled JPEG preview; no seam blending, smoothing, recolor or program-drawn terrain.
